text:
zara: FYI the nightly docs build failed linkcheck after the mkdocs->docusaurus migration. Seeing two categories: (A) duplicate slugs from numbered headings (e.g. multiple `1. Overview` inside subsections producing the same `#1-overview` anchor) and (B) a couple of remote image urls returning 404 during linkcheck which mkdocs used to ignore but our docusaurus link checker treats as hard failures.

devdocs-bot: CI: docs/nightly #2123 failed at step `linkcheck` — logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/2123/logs (error snippet included below)

zara: error excerpt: ```
ERROR linkcheck: anchors: docs/guides/scale.md: anchor collision: '#1-overview' already defined (from heading '1. Overview')
ERROR linkcheck: remote image broken: docs/guides/ops.md: https://assets.example.com/old/ops-diagram.png (HTTP 404)
```

julien: I ran into the numbered-heading slug issue before. Docusaurus slugify converts `1. Overview` -> `1-overview` and doesn't dedupe across nested sections. Two quick options: 1) add explicit heading ids (e.g. `### 1. Overview {#1-overview-scale}`) or 2) enable a remark plugin to generate stable custom ids during the migration. Option 1 is low-friction but manual. Option 2 is better long-term for bulk files.

pat: for the remote images: some of those URLs are from the old CDN deprecation. We should update to the canonical asset path under `docs/assets/` and add alt text while we're touching files. I can do a small bot-assisted PR to copy the assets over and rewrite the URLs.

julien: i'm leaning to a mixed approach: add a short migration script that scans for duplicate slug candidates and either auto-suggests `{#...}` ids or writes a report. Then we can append a commit with the chosen explicit ids. I'll draft the script and a runnable `yarn docs:migrate-slugs` that previews changes.

pat: can the script detect numbered headings inside admonitions/code captions? Those are the surprising ones: nested `1. Overview` inside a NOTE produces the same slug as the top-level `1. Overview`. If we can flag those, authors can either add `{#...}` or reword (e.g., "Overview (scale)").

julien: yes, goal is to find collisions regardless of context. Example pseudo-output: ```
docs/guides/scale.md: duplicate slug '#1-overview' from headings: [line 12: '1. Overview', line 108: '1. Overview (example)']
Suggestion: add `{#1-overview-scale}` to the lower heading.
```

zara: please avoid changing the user-visible human text unless necessary. Prefer `{#...}` suffixes with a short suffix token (e.g., `-scale`, `-ops`) so external anchors people link to won't silently break. If we must remove an old anchor, add a redirect in `docs/redirects.json`.

devdocs-bot: PR #821 opened by julien: add slug-migration script and docs:migrate-slugs preview command. CI queued.

pat: opened PR #822 with asset move for ops diagrams and alt text updates for three images. local `yarn docs:linkcheck` now passes on those pages.

ci-bot: PR #822 checks: linkcheck passed locally, CI started.

julien: also updating docs/migration/slug-guidelines.md with recommended patterns and a note about numbered headings and lists producing numeric-first slugs. Short example included: ```md
### 1. Overview {#1-overview-scale}
```

zara: nice. for the redirect plan: can you add an entry mapping `#1-overview` -> `#1-overview-scale` in `docs/redirects.json` for the handful of public guides that already had inbound links tracked by analytics? We should target high-traffic pages only.

julien: will do. I'll also add a small unit test around the slug scanner so it flags future regressions in PRs.

pat: once PRs merge, i'll run a smoke-check across localized docs too. Some of the translated pages had hand-edited headings that might collide differently.

zara: great. let's keep PRs small and atomic: one for assets/alt text, one for slug fixes/guidelines, one for ci script. If CI still fails after these, we'll pair for 15 to examine the full linkcheck stack trace. Thanks :raised_hands:

devdocs-bot: PR #821 checks 91% passing so far, test queue continuing.

ci-bot: nightly re-run scheduled after merges.

julien: note to reviewers: try `yarn docs:migrate-slugs --preview` to see suggested edits before applying. The tool only writes changes when `--apply` is passed.

pat: merging #822 when green.

zara: closing the follow-up ticket once nightly clears. If anyone sees new 404s coming from redirects, ping infra so we can add CDN rewrites.

julien: filed followup issue #408 for adding the slug-checker to pre-merge hooks.

pat: thanks all, will coordinate the localization smoke run after #821 is in. :shipit:
